verdict_summary: No critical. No live XSS (sole innerHTML sink renders union literals; all instance text via textContent). LLM API key handling clean. Transport-layer prod guard (sn-rest re-classifies per request) caps several UI-layer issues at medium.

findings.description: resolveScope() silently falls back to 'global' when the typed scope name doesn't resolve (typo, list not loaded, query failed, >1000 scopes unpaged). Confirm dialogs show scopeLabel() = raw typed text. User confirms 'in scope "My Aap"' -> record silently created in GLOBAL scope; confirmation describes a write target that is not the actual target.
findings.suggested_fix: Return null on unresolved -> block write with visible error, or show resolved scope in the dialog. Same for resolveUpdateSet.

findings.description: l3Created stores {table,sysId} without host; delete runs against current.host read AFTER the confirm await. Create on sub-prod A, switch tab to sub-prod B, Delete -> executes on B; migrated records share sys_ids -> can hard-delete a REAL record on another instance. Dialog doesn't name the host. Prod blocked by transport gate; other sub-prods exposed.
findings.suggested_fix: Store host in l3Created, delete against stored host, clear on host change, name host in confirm.

findings.description: TOCTOU across confirmation: all write flows re-read module-level `current` after await confirmDialog; detect() reassigns current on tab switch -> write executes against NEW host, not the one named in the dialog. l3Allowed only checked at entry. Capped medium: sn-rest re-classifies per request (prod refused), but misdirected writes on wrong sub-prod possible.
findings.suggested_fix: Snapshot host/scope/update-set into locals BEFORE dialog; use only locals after await; re-classify after confirm; or cancel dialogs on host change.

findings.description: detect() on every tabs.onActivated/onUpdated unconditionally re-fetches and scriptEd.setValue()s -> user's unsaved editor edits silently lost on tab switch+return; also clobbers selScope and l3Table selections.
findings.suggested_fix: Auto-load only when host/table/sysId changed vs loadedScriptRecord; skip setValue when editor dirty; offer 'Reload from record'.

findings.description: Completed LLM review delivered twice (direct reply + storage.session onChanged); applyReviewJob done-path APPENDS notes to lintResults without clearing -> every note renders twice, possibly seconds apart (looks like new findings).
findings.suggested_fix: Per-job applied token to ignore repeat 'done', or idempotent render into replaceChildren'd container.

findings.description: sendMessage(...).catch(()=>{}) swallows messaging failures after UI already set to 'running' -> permanent fake-running spinner; reopening restores stale 'running' from storage.session forever.
findings.suggested_fix: Write {status:'error'} job entry in catch; staleness timeout in restoreLlmJobs.

findings.description: List export stores whole-table raw XML + parsed records in one chrome.storage.local item; no unlimitedStorage (~10MB quota). Large export -> set() rejects unhandled -> stuck on 'Exporting list XML…', clip silently not saved.
findings.suggested_fix: try/catch + surface quota error; stop storing raw XML (records suffice for pasteXml); or unlimitedStorage.

findings.description: (1) mouseenter+click both open(); second open() overwrites single pop ref -> first popup orphaned on <body> until reload. (2) showChoices awaits fetch; mouseleave during fetch -> close() runs while pop null, popup appended after with nothing to remove it.
findings.suggested_fix: if(pop)return in open(); cancellation flag checked after await; or single reusable popup element.

findings.description: (a) Picker rows capture table+sysId only; current!.host read at CLICK time -> TypeError when current null, or loads same-sys_id record from a DIFFERENT instance and points 'Save to record' at it. (b) populateScopeBar stamps lastScopeHost before await -> stale scope/update-set maps shown for wrong host; failed query never retried.
findings.suggested_fix: Capture host per row; disable picker on host change. Stamp lastScopeHost only after success; ignore stale responses by comparing current.host after await.

findings.description: Only innerHTML sink; safe today (closed union types), latent hazard inviting future instance-text callers.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace html:true with textContent pill helper; delete html option.

findings.description: (a) Prompt font from fonts.googleapis.com: leaks panel-open to Google, fails offline, breaks under tightened CSP. (b) Header logo '/public/brand/...' likely 404s in one build layout (main.ts:1896-1899 documents Vite strips public/).
findings.suggested_fix: Bundle font or system fallback; use packaged path or dual-path fallback.

findings.description: Listener removed only on status 'complete'; tab closed early -> listener leaks for panel lifetime.
findings.suggested_fix: Also remove on tabs.onRemoved or ~30s timeout.

findings.description: Full DOM rebuild per keystroke for up to ~1000 rows; file already has the better pattern (renderL3Diff toggles row.hidden).
findings.suggested_fix: Build once, toggle hidden; or debounce.

findings.description: 'runBackground -> extractBgOutput -> regex snJava: marker -> branch' hand-rolled at 6+ sites with divergent error truncation/marker regexes.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract runBgMarked(host,script,opts) helper; route all six through it.

findings.description: Scope-confirm sentence assembled inline 5x; modal boilerplate repeated 4x; getLogoDataUri/getLogoBytes duplicate fetch loop; detect() has byte-identical if/else-if branches (dead branch); updateGuard() called twice in detect().
findings.suggested_fix: confirmScopedWrite()/makeModal()/fetchBrandAsset(); collapse identical branches; drop redundant updateGuard call.

no_findings: LLM API key: storage.local, password input, never logged/DOM-attributed
purpose_notes_condensed: startLlmJob/applyJob/restoreLlmJobs: dual delivery (reply + storage mirror) is deliberate so jobs survive panel close; spinners reappear on reopen.
getListQueryFromPage: GlideList2 injection needed because Next Experience/post-load filters never reach the URL; removal would export whole table.
saveXml root-record filter: form '&XML' unload is DEEP (drags related rows); keeps only on-screen sys_id (else first record).
pasteXml clip consumption: one-shot semantics (989425d) — re-paste would duplicate since sys_ids dropped.
buildMultiInsertScript: background-script inserts (not Table API) for update-set capture + scoped tables; setWorkflow(false) intentional (916325f).
buildGuardedInsertScript/renderL3Diff: dumps inserted record vs initialize()d defaults to attribute changes to 'you' vs BR/platform.
parseSnjava: balanced-brace scanner because sys.scripts.do embeds JSON in HTML noise.
extractBgOutput: DOMParser is inert (textContent only) — no XSS.
openBackgroundScripts: classic sys.scripts.do chosen (plain textarea fillable); retries 6x700ms; clipboard fallback.
updateGuard: UI-layer gate only; authoritative gate re-checked per request in sn-rest.
getAllFieldNames: dictionary misses inherited columns; unions with a real record's keys.
fieldAlreadyExists: checks element/column_name/parenthesized title; prefix variants both ways (u_/x_app_).
createsScope/stripScopeFields: guardrail from a1d5d7a — Generate must never create scope/app/update-set or choose its own scope.
promptDialog/confirmDialog: window.prompt/confirm no-op in side panels; in-panel modals; promptDialog deliberately doesn't cancel on outside click.
getLogoDataUri/getLogoBytes: dual candidate paths because Vite strips public/ while @crxjs mirrors it (bcda1ec); caches undefined-as-resolved.
exportPdf: print() injected into blob tab; 60s revoke delay so tab finishes loading.
detect(): URL parse primary; content-script enrichment best-effort ('Receiving end does not exist' expected).
createCodeEditor: CodeMirror 6 chosen for MV3 CSP (no eval).
fetchChoices: falls back to element-name-only query because inherited fields store choices under parent table.

unclear_code.note: if(context?.table) and else if(context) branches byte-identical — dead split.
updateGuard() called twice in detect(); second call purpose unclear.
comma-expression side effect inside ternary; easy to misread.
scopeLabel (typed text) vs resolveScope (silent global fallback) can disagree — source of high finding.
l3Results aliases simResults; Simulate and guarded-run logs overwrite each other — intended UX unclear.
lookbehind interaction with sub-prod list subtle ('non_prod' classifies prod=blocked — safe but surprising); deserves comment/test.
